Separate published model added for unambiguous allele matching. Better matching does not establish better prediction. Original models remain available; scores and terms are never combined.

52-term published testicular cancer model. Original log(OR) weights verified row by row. UK Biobank coordinate annotations checked against original positions and source allele or its complement; these annotations do not resolve palindromic strand ambiguity.

catalogAlternative.reason: PGS Catalog identifies this as an author-supplied alternative because the original published score is unavailable. Details and performance may differ from the Coleman 2020 publication; its reported performance must not be assumed to validate this exact file.

coverageContext: PGC-derived author-supplied alternative using the 2018 major-depression GWAS with UK Biobank excluded. Not the exact score used in the paper; published performance may differ. Kept separate from other depression models.

Eight-variant research score using depression GWAS PMID 30718901, evaluated in a study of childhood cognition and brain correlates (PMID 36653486). This does not establish diagnostic prediction of depression. Evaluation ancestry is not reported. Kept separate from the other depression models; effect-only allele ambiguity is not silently resolved.
Research score evaluated alongside diabetes in a pancreatic cancer study. GA reports the genetic weighted sum, not the combined clinical model or an absolute cancer probability.

Research score using European-discovery Parkinson's associations, evaluated in a study of olfaction among middle-aged to older women. It does not diagnose Parkinson's disease or predict individual symptom progression.

European-discovery lupus research score evaluated for disease onset and outcomes. GA calculates only the additive genetic component; it cannot predict individual damage, survival or treatment response.
Thirteen-variant gout research score. It is not a serum urate measurement, a diagnostic test, or a treatment recommendation. Missing comparison alleles are not invented.

Research score evaluated for incident venous thromboembolism after COVID-19 vaccination in middle-aged and older adults. It does not establish vaccine causation or support personal vaccination or anticoagulation decisions.
Research score studied alongside lifestyle factors for thyroid cancer. GA does not reproduce the combined clinical or lifestyle model and does not estimate absolute cancer risk.

PRS-CS research model from a small Taiwanese study, with East Asian discovery and evaluation. Limited sample size and ancestry transferability restrict interpretation; it is not a diagnostic test. EUR comparisons are withheld by the evaluation-population safeguard.

Research model developed and evaluated in Han Chinese samples. GA withholds EUR comparisons because the reference population is not represented in reported evaluation. It does not diagnose epilepsy, predict seizures, or guide medication.

Published additive venous thromboembolism research score. It does not identify an acute clot, provide absolute risk, or guide anticoagulant use; study-specific covariate models are not reproduced by GA.

Research model evaluated prospectively in European women aged 50–74. It does not reproduce an absolute-risk model, establish a screening recommendation, or replace assessment of high-penetrance variants.

Type 1 diabetes association-weighted research score evaluated for cystic-fibrosis-related diabetes, not validated here as a general-population type 1 diabetes diagnostic model. Evaluation ancestry is unreported. GA does not determine diabetes type or treatment.

Research model of diabetes onset among people with cystic fibrosis and severe CFTR mutations and/or exocrine pancreatic insufficiency. It is not a cystic fibrosis diagnosis or a general-population diabetes score. Evaluation ancestry is unreported; GA does not estimate onset age, absolute hazard or treatment need.

Small Chinese study of early-pregnancy gestational diabetes. GA reports only the genetic component, not the combined clinical prediction model. East Asian evaluation means EUR comparisons are withheld; this cannot replace pregnancy glucose screening or clinical care.

Research model developed and evaluated in European samples. Reported evaluation overlaps development samples; GA does not reproduce the combined immune-cell/clinical model or claim independent diagnostic validation.

Research model developed predominantly in male European-ancestry samples, with European and African evaluation groups. It does not detect an existing aneurysm, predict rupture, or establish an imaging or surgery recommendation; clinical covariates are not reproduced.

Vitiligo-associated research model evaluated for anti-PD-L1-induced hypothyroidism in cancer patients, not for diagnosis of vitiligo. European evaluation does not establish general-population predictive utility. GA cannot predict immunotherapy response or guide treatment.

Research score evaluated for peripheral artery disease among UK Biobank participants with type 2 diabetes. GA does not reproduce the combined clinical/lifestyle model, diagnose impaired circulation or estimate absolute risk. Applicability outside this evaluation setting is unestablished.

Research model evaluated in a Chinese IgA nephropathy cohort. EUR comparisons are withheld because reported evaluation is East Asian. GA does not diagnose nephropathy, reproduce a clinical workup, or predict individual kidney failure or treatment benefit.

UK Biobank depression research model trained in European participants and evaluated across ancestry groups. Reported partial correlations are small and several intervals include zero; representation in evaluation does not establish predictive utility or individual applicability. GA does not reproduce covariate adjustment, diagnose depression, estimate absolute risk, or predict treatment response. Build-specific alleles, where needed, require unique reciprocal assembly-chain mappings and exact reverse-complement reference flanks; original weights and source alleles remain unchanged.

European-evaluation research score studied across chronic lymphocytic leukemia and other non-Hodgkin lymphoma subtypes. Subtypes remain distinct; the score is not a blood test, a cancer diagnosis, an absolute-risk estimate or a screening recommendation.

Three common-variant research model evaluated for ajmaline-induced type I Brugada ECG changes in a European clinical cohort. It is not a diagnosis of Brugada syndrome, a sudden-death predictor, or a substitute for rare-variant and clinical assessment; it cannot guide a drug challenge or medication.

Common-variant research score evaluated for hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, including analyses stratified by rare sarcomere variants. It does not identify or exclude a pathogenic rare variant, diagnose cardiomyopathy, or predict individual sudden-death risk. Cohort and ancestry applicability remain limited.

Research score evaluated for keratoconus in European UK Biobank participants. GA preserves the deposited genetic weights but does not reproduce a clinical eye examination, diagnose keratoconus, estimate absolute risk, or determine treatment.

Research score evaluated for type 1 diabetes across five biobanks. Performance varies substantially between cohorts; the South Asian evaluation interval includes no association and discrimination was close to chance. This is not the cystic-fibrosis-related diabetes endpoint of PGS000869, nor a diagnosis, antibody test, calibrated probability or treatment guide.

UK Biobank sarcoidosis research score, mapped by the Catalog to skin sarcoidosis. Reported partial correlations are small and most intervals include zero. Multi-ancestry evaluation does not establish reliable individual prediction; this does not diagnose sarcoidosis or determine organ involvement.

Genetic component of a UK Biobank study of incident idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis and residential greenness. The covariate-adjusted study association is not a personal hazard ratio; GA does not model greenness, exposures, clinical factors, diagnosis or absolute disease risk.

Genetic component evaluated for incident peptic ulcer in European UK Biobank participants in an air-pollution study. GA does not reproduce pollution interactions or the adjusted clinical model. This score cannot identify an active ulcer, its cause or a treatment, and is not an absolute-risk estimate.

FinnGen-derived genetic component evaluated for gallstones in European UK Biobank participants. The publication also examines lifestyle interactions; GA does not compute those interactions or assign study risk tertiles from its reference ranks. Not a diagnosis, personal probability or surgery recommendation.

Han Chinese TPMI research score for a broad coded alcohol-related-disorders endpoint, including psychiatric and medical complications. Evaluation had 185 cases and included clinical covariates; GA computes only the deposited genetic component. It does not establish alcohol use, dependence, behavior, character or future choices, and cannot guide alcohol consumption or treatment. European reference ranks are withheld because reported evaluation is East Asian.

Research model evaluated for neuroblastoma in African American children, with 629 cases and 2,990 controls; European-derived weights explained limited variance in that evaluation. Not an adult cancer model, a diagnosis, an inherited cancer syndrome test or a screening recommendation. EUR reference ranks are withheld because reported evaluation is African ancestry.

Research score evaluated for diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and other non-Hodgkin lymphoma subtypes in European participants. Subtypes are not interchangeable. This five-term genetic model is not a diagnosis, tumor classification, absolute-risk estimate, treatment guide or blood-test substitute.

Chinese-population research model evaluated for esophageal cancer in the China Kadoorie Biobank. Reported Cox-model performance includes age, sex, region and ancestry principal components; GA computes only the genetic component. European reference ranks are withheld. Not a diagnosis, personal probability or endoscopy recommendation.

UK Biobank research model for a broad dementia endpoint, not a specific dementia subtype or a measurement of cognition. Reported evaluation partial correlations are small; one European interval includes zero. Multi-ancestry evaluation does not establish applicability to every individual. This is not an APOE haplotype determination, a diagnosis, age-of-onset estimate, personal probability or treatment guide.

Complete 15-term bladder-cancer research model. Original NR weight metadata is retained; every deposited weight is independently checked against the logarithm of its original OR. Three UK Biobank coordinate labels are annotations, not scoring conditions. This is not the 24-term model containing a GSTM1 deletion proxy. Published covariate-adjusted or smoking-related performance is not the raw genetic sum; no diagnosis, personal probability or screening recommendation is provided.

Han Chinese TPMI research model, with a broader thyrotoxicosis/orbital-code training definition and a Graves-specific evaluation of 225 cases. Reported performance includes sex, age, array and ancestry covariates; GA computes only the genetic component. EUR reference ranks are withheld. Not a thyroid-hormone or antibody test, diagnosis, medication guide or calibrated personal probability.

East Asian research model evaluated for gastric cancer in two cohorts. Reported hazard ratios include clinical/demographic covariates and are not personal risk or GA performance. The source study examined H. pylori treatment, but GA computes only the genetic sum and makes no infection-status or treatment-benefit inference. EUR ranks are withheld; not an H. pylori test, screening recommendation or diagnosis.

UK Biobank research score for the combined reported endpoint of diagnosed coeliac disease OR gluten sensitivity, not a biopsy-confirmed coeliac-only diagnosis. Evaluated partial correlations are small and several confidence intervals include zero, with ancestry-dependent results. Not an HLA typing result, antibody measurement, food-intolerance test or dietary/treatment recommendation. GA does not reproduce the covariate-adjusted published model.

UK Biobank research model for ulcerative colitis, kept separate from the broader inflammatory-bowel-disease score. Reported partial correlations are small and ancestry-dependent, with several intervals including zero. GA does not reproduce the covariate-adjusted study model. Not a Crohn disease score, inflammation measurement, diagnosis, flare prediction or medication guide.

Han Chinese TPMI research model for primary liver malignancy, with broader liver/intrahepatic training codes and history-of-cancer codes in the evaluation definition; 390 evaluation cases. It is not a hepatocellular-carcinoma-only model. Published performance includes sex, age, array and ancestry covariates, not GA genetics alone. EUR ranks are withheld. No inference of current cancer, hepatitis status, tumor subtype or screening/treatment need.

East Asian nasopharyngeal-carcinoma research score, kept separate from other head-and-neck cancers. Reported AUROC differs for the genetic score alone and with family history. External evaluation includes an EBV VCA-IgA interaction; GA does not infer EBV infection or antibody status and does not calculate that interaction or its large group odds ratio. EUR ranks are withheld. No personal cancer probability, screening recommendation or treatment inference.

UK Biobank research model for diabetic retinopathy with small, ancestry-dependent partial correlations and several intervals including zero. The deposited evaluation does not establish a diabetes-only conditional risk model. GA does not infer diabetes status, retinal damage, severity, progression or screening need. This is not a retinal examination, visual-acuity estimate or covariate-adjusted clinical prediction.

Published complete 858-term gene-based PRS-CSx research model evaluated in African American COGA, SAGE and Yale-Penn cohorts (6,315 participants). The original posterior weights are retained. EUR ranks are withheld; the separate European study used only 847 terms and does not validate this complete model there. Published analyses adjusted for sex, ancestry PCs, cohort and family structure where applicable. Important source discrepancy: Catalog labels OR 1.76 as top 10% versus rest, while the primary article's methods, results and Table 3 specify top versus bottom decile. GA does not apply either odds ratio to a person. Not a diagnosis, drinking-behavior forecast, character judgment or treatment guide.

Complete seven-term UK Biobank BASIL/snpnet research model for a combined Sjogren/sicca endpoint. Exact publication and source hashes establish additive use of unchanged regression coefficients; Catalog weight type remains NR, with no odds-ratio transformation. Held-out white British evaluation had 135 cases and genetic-only AUROC about0.603; other ancestry groups had very small case counts. Clinical-covariate performance is not GA genetic-score performance. Not a diagnosis, confirmation of autoimmune disease, symptom explanation or treatment guide.

Complete UK Biobank basal-cell-carcinoma-weighted research model evaluated against the broader keratinocyte-cancer endpoint in 18,933 Canadian Longitudinal Study on Aging participants of European ancestry. This is not a separately validated basal-cell-only personal prediction. Study odds ratios included age, sex and ancestry covariates; GA computes only the genetic component. Not a skin examination, lesion classification, UV-exposure measurement, screening schedule or calibrated cancer probability.

Han Chinese TPMI research model for coded noninfectious or unspecified uveitis, evaluated in 128 cases and16,930 controls. Published AUROC includes sex, age, array and ancestry covariates, not GA genetics alone. EUR ranks are withheld. Not an assessment of current eye inflammation, infection exclusion, inflammatory subtype, vision loss, diagnosis or treatment need.

Complete 47-term European-ancestry RBD research model; reported discrimination was modest (AUROC about0.61 for isolated RBD and0.60 for Parkinson disease with probable RBD). The primary paper's third comparison is Parkinson disease without probable RBD, although Catalog labels it probable RBD; retain this source discrepancy when reading evaluation records. The score did not predict age at onset or conversion to overt neurodegeneration. Not a sleep-study result, diagnosis, or prediction of future Parkinson disease or dementia.

Complete26-term SparSNP lasso-linear JIA model trained in a European UK cohort and externally evaluated in CHOP and CLARITY childhood cohorts. Catalog units remain NR; exact primary-method evidence establishes an additive sum, not a log-odds scale. Genetic-only AUROC was0.657 and0.671; higher0.735/0.738values include sex and ancestry covariates not reproduced by GA. Not an adult rheumatoid-arthritis score, JIA subtype diagnosis, assessment of active inflammation, or treatment recommendation.

Complete 29-term nonsyndromic cleft lip with or without cleft palate research model. BioVU evaluation included only 46 cases and 72,496 controls of non-Hispanic European ancestry (AUROC 0.66), so the large total sample does not imply many affected participants. The separate PDGFRA family experiments are not part of this additive score. This is not a syndromic-variant test, prenatal screen, carrier assessment, future-child risk calculation, or reproductive recommendation.

Complete UK Biobank penalized-regression research model for coded corneal dystrophy. Six ancestry-group evaluations reported adjusted partial correlations, not diagnostic probabilities; European correlations were modest (about 0.038 to 0.075), and non-European intervals included zero. The EUR reference cannot establish applicability to an individual. This is not a corneal examination, dystrophy-subtype or monogenic-variant test, prognosis of vision loss, or treatment recommendation.

Complete 654-term UK Biobank penalized-regression model for coded disorders of iron metabolism. Covariate-adjusted partial correlations were about 0.131 in the UK group and 0.109 in the Polish group; the Italian and non-European intervals included zero. This is a broad coded endpoint, not a serum iron or ferritin measurement, a diagnosis of iron deficiency or hereditary hemochromatosis, an HFE diplotype test, or a basis for iron supplements or phlebotomy. GA preserves the genetic sum without reproducing clinical covariates or calculating disease probability.

Complete 22-term UK Biobank penalized-regression model for coded disorders of bilirubin excretion. Covariate-adjusted partial correlations in European evaluation groups were modest (about 0.057–0.072); non-European results were near zero or uncertain. This is not a serum bilirubin measurement, Gilbert syndrome diagnosis, UGT1A1 diplotype test, or basis for medication selection or dosing. GA preserves the genetic sum without reproducing clinical covariates or calculating disease probability.

Complete 94-term TPMI Han Chinese model evaluated for gallbladder cholesterolosis (575.6/K82.4). Training used a broader set of biliary/gallbladder diagnoses and abnormal imaging codes; this is not a cholesterolosis-specific development phenotype. Evaluation included only 154 cases and 18,611 controls, with AUROC about 0.722 adjusted for sex, age, array and ten principal components; this is not genetic-only or GA performance. No European evaluation is deposited, so GA withholds European reference ranks. The raw genetic sum does not diagnose gallbladder polyps, distinguish malignancy, predict gallstones, or guide imaging or surgery.

Complete 16-term TPMI Han Chinese model for the deposited chronic-sinusitis endpoint, whose case codes also include postnasal drip (473, 784.91, J32, R09.82). Development and evaluation report the same code list. Evaluation included 634 cases and 15,426 controls; AUROC about 0.643 includes sex, age, array and ten principal components and is not genetic-only or GA performance. No European evaluation is deposited, so GA withholds European reference ranks. This is not a diagnosis, an infection-versus-allergy classifier, or a basis for antibiotics or sinus surgery.

Complete 45-term UK Biobank model for coded congenital deficiency of other clotting factors, including factor VII. Covariate-adjusted partial correlations were modest (about 0.038–0.056 in European groups and 0.035 in a South Asian group); case counts and detailed case definitions are not deposited. This polygenic sum does not identify a pathogenic factor-gene variant, establish carrier status, measure clotting-factor activity, diagnose a bleeding disorder or predict procedural bleeding. It must not guide anticoagulation, factor replacement or surgery. GA does not reproduce clinical covariates or disease probabilities.

Complete 40-term TPMI Han Chinese score trained on broad arthropathy codes, then evaluated for the deposited palindromic-rheumatism endpoint (719.3, M12.3, M12.4). Training and evaluation definitions differ; the evaluation code list also includes intermittent hydrarthrosis. Only 161 cases were included among 17,549 evaluated participants. AUROC about 0.882 includes sex, age, array and ten principal components, not genetic-only or GA performance. No European evaluation is deposited, so European reference ranks are withheld. This sum does not diagnose recurrent joint attacks, predict conversion to rheumatoid arthritis, or guide immunosuppression.

Complete 388-term TPMI Han Chinese model for the broad hereditary hemolytic-anemia code group (282, D55–D58), not any specific molecular subtype. Development and evaluation report the same code list. Evaluation included only 98 cases among 18,170 participants; AUROC about 0.826 includes sex, age, array and ten principal components and is not genetic-only or GA performance. No European evaluation is deposited, so European reference ranks are withheld. This polygenic sum is not a test for thalassemia, sickle-cell disease, G6PD deficiency, a pathogenic gene variant, carrier status, reproductive risk or medication-related hemolysis. It neither replaces the separate variant-interpretation layers nor guides transfusion or drug decisions.

Complete 49-term research model for colorectal cancer diagnosed before age 50. European discovery; UK Biobank evaluation had 723 cases and 24,427 controls, predominantly European, with very few non-European cases. The deposited adjusted quartile-4 versus quartile-1 OR is 1.64 [1.32,2.03]; the article main text reports 1.63 [1.32,2.02]. Preserve that source discrepancy rather than treating either as personal risk. Published AUC improvements for combined 86+49-term models do not describe this 49-term sum. This is not a Lynch syndrome/FAP test, diagnosis, age-of-onset forecast, calibrated absolute risk or colonoscopy recommendation.

Complete PRS21 research model evaluated in 55,266 never-smoking Chinese women in China Kadoorie Biobank, despite the broader Catalog trait label. The reported HR1.29 [1.18,1.41] includes clinical covariates and ancestry principal components; GA calculates only the original genetic sum, not that covariate-adjusted model or calibrated absolute risk. Published AUC0.711 concerns a combined clinical-plus-genetic model, not GA. Applicability to men, smokers or other ancestry populations is not established. No European evaluation is deposited, so European reference ranks are withheld. Not a diagnosis, reassurance against lung cancer or a screening/CT recommendation.

Complete16-term PRSweb Hodgkin-lymphoma code-group research model. Primary methods independently document additive use, while the deposited weight label remains NR and coefficients remain unchanged. MGI European evaluation included only71cases/704controls; adjusted AUROC0.601[0.535,0.671] indicates modest discrimination. The top1% comparison is highly uncertain (OR1.62[0.258,10.1]). Do not treat these study metrics as GA performance, personal probability, tumor detection, prognosis, subtype classification or screening/treatment guidance. No non-European applicability is established.

European UK Biobank PheCode204.4 research score: includes myeloma, plasmacytoma and related coded malignancies rather than a pathology-confirmed uniform subtype. Evaluation248cases/2490controls showed modest association (per-SD OR1.327, AUROC0.577); the top1%comparison was uncertain, OR2.2[0.855,5.66]. Reported estimates include age, sex, batch and PCs; GA computes only the deposited genetic sum without study standardization. Not a diagnosis, MGUS progression prediction, disease-activity/prognosis measure, screening recommendation or calibrated personal probability; non-European portability is unestablished.

Han Chinese TPMI chronic-thyroiditis research score, mapped by the Catalog to Hashimoto thyroiditis, with broader chronic-thyroiditis evaluation codes and 260 evaluation cases. GA does not reproduce the covariate-adjusted study model. EUR ranks are withheld. Not a thyroid-hormone or antibody measurement, a diagnosis, a prediction of current thyroid function or a treatment guide.

Complete published 15-term PRS-CC, including its exactly reviewed deletion; no terms removed. Evaluated prospectively in 57,359 Chinese women (237 incident cases) over median 11.33 years. Adjusted HR per SD 1.20 [1.06,1.36]; the reported C-index 0.566 includes covariates and is not GA genetic-only performance. GA provides only the original unstandardized genetic sum, not personal absolute risk, diagnosis or prediction of HPV infection/persistence. Portability outside the evaluated population is unestablished; European reference comparisons are withheld. Not a basis for changing HPV vaccination, HPV/Pap screening, follow-up or treatment. Deletion population frequencies and whole-model reference rankings are unavailable; missing, conflicting or unsupported genotypes cannot supply a complete score.

Complete 288-variant Han Chinese pulmonary-embolism research score, distinct from the installed broader venous-thromboembolism models. Study testing used 646 cases/8810 controls after a separate discovery sample; the SNP p-value threshold was selected for the largest testing AUC, so reported AUROC0.765 is not an untouched external validation or GA performance. The primary paper describes top10% versus30-70% OR5.08; the Catalog quantile label is inconsistent and is not used to assign personal risk. GA retains only the original genetic sum, without study standardization. EUR rank withheld; transferability outside the evaluated population is unestablished. Not evidence for a current clot, future absolute probability, anticoagulant choice or emergency-care decision; low genetic scores cannot rule out pulmonary embolism.

Complete 68-variant QT-interval research score using original QT GWAS beta coefficients. GA reports the genetic sum, not measured or predicted ECG milliseconds or the study-standardized score. European evaluation included 1238 LQTS cases and 8219 controls; 1115 cases carried a rare major-gene variant and only 123 were genotype negative. Japanese analyses used 60/68 variants plus a proxy, so their results and combined-ancestry results do not validate this exact full 68-term definition. Catalog ancestry summaries retain those study records but must not imply full-model transferability. This is a cardiac electrophysiology research trait, not a long-QT diagnosis, absolute disease probability, cardiac-event prediction, medication-safety test or substitute for an ECG or clinical rare-variant assessment.

Complete 31-variant free-thyroxine (FT4) research score using adult-GWAS coefficients, evaluated in 7231 European-ancestry children from Generation R, ALSPAC and BLTS (median ages6.0,7.5 and12.1years). Reported explained FT4 variation differed across cohorts (1.5%-4.2%); age-dependent effects and this pediatric evaluation do not establish adult or neonatal full-score prediction. The primary models adjusted for age, sex and four ancestry principal components although Catalog covariates are blank. GA retains the unstandardized genetic sum, not a measured hormone concentration, laboratory reference interval, thyroid diagnosis, neonatal screen or levothyroxine dose. Cross-trait associations with TSH/FT3 are not additional validated scores or personal laboratory predictions.

Complete 44-term PR-interval research score with original GWAS beta weights. Evaluation involved 1257 European-ancestry patients referred for suspected Brugada syndrome and ajmaline testing, not a general screening cohort. Baseline PR correlation was modest; the PR slope association was not significant in the full multivariable analysis (P=0.062). GA reports a genetic sum, not measured ECG milliseconds, drug response, Brugada diagnosis, medication safety or dosing advice. The separate combined Brugada clinical model's C-statistic does not validate this score alone. No prospective clinical utility or non-European transportability is established here.

Complete 26-term QRS-duration research score with original GWAS beta weights. Evaluation involved 1257 European-ancestry patients referred for suspected Brugada syndrome and ajmaline testing, not a general screening cohort. QRS associations with baseline ECG and ajmaline response were modest and do not establish individual drug toxicity or event prediction. GA reports a genetic sum, not measured ECG milliseconds, Brugada diagnosis, medication safety or dosing advice. The separate combined Brugada clinical model's C-statistic does not validate this score alone. No prospective clinical utility or non-European transportability is established here.

Complete seven-term IgE research score using the original adult-derived GWAS beta coefficients. Evaluation is from the Dutch TRAILS adolescent cohort; the primary abstract describes 1354 participants overall and a third-wave mean age of16.22years, but trait-specific evaluation sample sizes must be read from the frozen Catalog record. This does not establish adult clinical prediction. GA reports only the genetic weighted sum, not a measured serum IgE concentration, allergen-specific sensitization, allergy/asthma diagnosis, anaphylaxis risk or treatment advice. Clinical usefulness and individual applicability are not established. The full deposited paper was not retrievable for detailed table verification in this review; no unverified paper-specific performance or transformation is applied.

Complete 12-term fasting-insulin research score using the deposited overlap-corrected beta coefficients. Evaluated in European-ancestry adolescents in the Dutch TRAILS cohort, mean age 16.22 years; Catalog reports sex/age-adjusted R-squared 0.0145. This is a genetic sum, not a measured insulin level, insulin-resistance diagnosis, diabetes risk probability, or medication/diet recommendation. The primary abstract supports adolescent evaluation; no unverified full-paper transformation is applied.

Complete five-term ExPRSweb C-reactive-protein research score. European Michigan Genomics Initiative evaluation reported R-squared 0.00456, with sex, age, batch and four ancestry principal components. Predictive contribution was small in this selected clinical cohort. GA applies the published genetic weights alone, not the adjusted study model. It does not measure current CRP or diagnose inflammation, infection, or cardiovascular disease; no treatment recommendation follows from its rank.

Complete 147-term eGFR-associated research score. The selected Catalog evaluations in 452264 European UK Biobank participants concern coded renal and cardiovascular diseases, not direct calibration of measured kidney function. Published bottom-versus-top-decile odds ratios are group comparisons and are never assigned from GA reference percentiles. The raw sum is not an eGFR laboratory result, kidney-disease stage, dialysis prediction or medication-dose calculation. Discovery included multiple ancestry groups; individual applicability is unestablished.

Complete 150-term ALT research score from European-ancestry discovery and replication, evaluated in Airwave and Northern Finland Birth Cohort samples. The paper reports an Airwave association per standard deviation of the study score; GA does not reproduce that study standardization. Both the paper and Catalog label the NFBC enzyme-level association as an odds ratio; this label is preserved without treating it as diagnostic risk. Raw genetic sums and reference ranks are not measured ALT in U/L, evidence of current liver injury, a liver-disease diagnosis or treatment advice.

Complete 14-term insulin-secretion-pathway research score using published log odds weights for type 2 diabetes loci. Evaluation concerns cystic-fibrosis-related diabetes onset in 5740 people with cystic fibrosis and severe CFTR mutations and/or pancreatic insufficiency, not insulin secretion in the general population. The Catalog does not report evaluation ancestry, so applicability of any EUR reference rank is unknown. The genetic sum is not a measured insulin level, a CF or diabetes diagnosis, a lifetime probability, or treatment advice.

Complete 20-term HCM research score. The paper studies shared common-variant pathways with opposite effects in hypertrophic and dilated cardiomyopathy and investigates phenotypic variability in carriers of rare HCM-causing variants. This does not replace rare-variant assessment, cardiac imaging, family history or clinical evaluation. Catalog evaluation ancestry is unspecified, so individual applicability of the EUR comparison is unknown. A reference rank is not penetrance, lifetime risk, a diagnosis, sudden-death prediction or a treatment/exercise recommendation.

Complete 14-term bladder-cancer research score, evaluated for incident bladder cancer in 400812 European UK Biobank participants. Catalog reports AUROC 0.583 (95% CI 0.559-0.607), indicating modest discrimination in that cohort. GA does not reproduce the study model or use its incidence/relative-risk estimates to calculate a personal lifetime probability. Genetic rank cannot diagnose or exclude cancer, interpret urinary symptoms, or determine screening or treatment.

Complete 15-term serous epithelial ovarian-cancer research score. Evaluated in 489 serous cases and 1428 controls nested within UKCTOCS, a trial of white European women selected for low familial ovarian-cancer risk. Reported discrimination was modest; relatives at high familial risk were underrepresented. The paper models absolute risk using population incidence and its own score distribution; those estimates are not applied to GA EUR reference percentiles. This endpoint is serous EOC, not every ovarian-cancer subtype. The genetic sum is not a lifetime probability, diagnostic test, or screening/surgery recommendation.

Complete 200-term GGT research score from European-ancestry discovery and replication, evaluated in Airwave and Northern Finland Birth Cohort samples. The paper uses standardized study scores; GA retains the deposited genetic sum only. The paper and Catalog label the NFBC enzyme-level association an odds ratio, which is not interpreted as diagnostic risk. Raw sums and reference ranks are not measured GGT in U/L, evidence of current liver injury or alcohol use, a liver-disease diagnosis, lifetime risk or treatment advice.

Complete 71-term atopic-eczema research score. Its selected evaluation concerns paradoxical eczema during biologic treatment for psoriasis in BSTOP: 88 events among 3212 European participants. Catalog reports AUROC 0.567 and a wide odds-ratio interval; this selected treatment cohort does not establish general-population prediction. The score is not a skin diagnosis, a drug-safety test, or a recommendation to start, stop or select a biologic. Study covariates and absolute risk are not reproduced by GA.

Complete 68-term research score. The source study evaluated cross-sectional suspected NAFLD using elevated ALT as a proxy in UK Biobank, excluding excessive alcohol intake and known alternative liver disease. The proxy is not imaging- or biopsy-confirmed fatty liver. Catalog sample records highlight 25716 suspected cases within an overall analysis of up to 242524 people; interaction findings with BMI, grip strength and activity are not personalized lifestyle forecasts. GA uses the genetic sum alone, not measured ALT, current liver fat, a diagnosis, lifetime risk, or treatment guidance.

Complete 155-term AF research score used in a prospective UK Biobank study of air pollution and genetic susceptibility involving 401251 participants initially without AF. Study hazard ratios for joint pollution/genetic categories are exposure-dependent associations, not effects to assign from GA genetic ranks. GA does not estimate pollution exposure or reproduce the adjusted Cox model. The score is not a diagnosis, remaining lifetime risk, stroke prediction, or advice to change medication.

Complete 122-term paroxysmal-AF research score selected from 30 candidate settings by cross-validation within a Japanese cohort. Its small held-out test and Japanese evaluation do not establish applicability to other populations; GA withholds EUR reference ranks for the explicit population mismatch. Combined clinical/machine-learning model AUC is not the performance of a raw genetic sum. It cannot detect a current arrhythmia, replace ECG monitoring, estimate lifetime risk, or guide anticoagulation.

Complete 142-term AF research score evaluated in the Danish Diet, Cancer and Health case-cohort study. The paper reports 3094 incident AF cases over median 12.9-year follow-up and examines interaction with lifestyle. Published incidence rates refer to combined lifestyle/genetic study groups; GA has neither those clinical inputs nor that calibrated model and does not assign those rates from reference percentiles. The genetic sum is not current rhythm, remaining lifetime risk, stroke prediction, or anticoagulation advice.

Complete unweighted 53-variant insulin-resistance research score: each deposited effect allele contributes one unit. Loci were selected jointly for higher BMI-adjusted fasting insulin, lower HDL and higher triglycerides. The study investigates reduced peripheral fat storage and several metabolic endpoints; raw allele counts are not measured insulin resistance or a clinical threshold. Published standardized associations and disease odds ratios are not applied to individual reference percentiles. This score does not diagnose diabetes or lipodystrophy or prescribe a diet or medicine.

Complete 32-term ischemic-stroke research score evaluated in 13,348 female breast-cancer survivors without baseline cardiovascular disease, including 165 ischemic-stroke events over median 8.01 years. Its selected study concerns joint genetic and lifestyle associations in this specific cohort. A raw genetic sum is not the adjusted clinical model, an individual causal lifestyle benefit, a treatment recommendation or a lifetime stroke probability.

The author release lists discovery PMID 28932557, while its linked CKDGen source identifies PMID 27920155, DOI 10.1681/ASN.2016020131. Original catalog source metadata is retained. Evaluation PPM015712 reports an association per standardized PRS and primary Table S4 confirms its R-squared; older author-release R-squared values are a distinct version. Published phenotype availability and deposited evaluation sample counts are not treated as interchangeable or automatically summed. The raw weighted sum does not predict creatinine concentration, estimated filtration or kidney-disease probability; no clinical threshold is supplied.
